answer.worked:
The altitude bisects the $10\text{ cm}$ base because the triangle is isosceles. Use Pythagoras' theorem:

$$\begin{aligned}h^2+5^2&=13^2\\h^2&=169-25=144\\h&=12\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$$
